Added: A review's question can be asked on GitHub for the PR's author (Ask the author on GitHub…): inline on the line it's about when that line is in the diff, else as a PR comment. Their replies show under the question; Use their reply as the answer sends them to the review's chat, and re-reviews read them on their own (`lfg review ask`, `lfg review replies`).

whats_new.title: Ask the PR's author
whats_new.text: When a review has a question only the PR's author can answer, press Ask the author on GitHub under it. It's posted on the line it's about, their reply shows under the question, and Use their reply as the answer lets the review update itself. Re-reviews read their replies too.
